about_the_game:
Protect a baby caterpillar from fearsome foes! But here's the twist: you never deal direct damage.

In Caterpillar King, you don’t control the Caterpillar. Instead, he moves on his own, always looking for his next meal. Your job is to keep him safe.

Caterpillar King combines thoughtful strategy, silly characters, and absurd humor in a short 2-3 hour narrative-puzzle journey. 

Every level is a handcrafted puzzle where you outsmart enemies by redirecting attacks and signaling the Caterpillar to safety.

Along the way, experience a heartwarming story full of laughter about returning the lost child of the Caterpillar King in exchange for a life-changing reward.

Key Features

  • Tactical grid-based puzzles with visible enemy intent

  • A Caterpillar that moves on his own. He's hungry, naive, and in constant need of protection

  • Bug allies each with their own unique abilities and funny personalities

  • Colorful 2D visuals inspired by children's books

  • Relaxing music for cozy vibes

  • Short and satisfying journey that lasts 2-3 hours
